description: Eight-step gate sequencer where each step fires on a probability set by its own knob

params.text: Sets how likely that step is to fire, never at the bottom and every time at the top

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves the sequence on one step, wrapping round after the eighth
A rising edge returns the sequence to the first step

outputs.text: 8V while no gate is being sent and 0V while one is
An 8V gate on the steps that fire, high for the first half of each clock period

notes: A step fires when its knob setting beats a random number drawn once, at the moment the step arrives.

inputs.0: high above 1.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1.5V · stepped · one channel only
